name: The Loyal Husband & The Wizard
author: Mlabbee
description:
Welcome to a platformer game that will challenge both your loyalty and your skill. A wizard has stolen your wife and the only way to get her back is to take on his challenging tower. Watch out though, as the wizard has made you a Tinder account to tempt you. Don't lose hope and fight till the end! (Try and find all 7 endings, 1 true ending, 1 secret ending, and 5 bad endings).

Sources:
Character Sprites By: Rachel Goniea
Character Controller: https://learn.unity.com/tutorial/live-session-2d-platformer-character-controller#
